properties.title: AOI — surroundings of Utsira island
properties.description: Polygon delimiting the broader study area around Utsira island (~3500 km²). Extends the Utsira Nord licence polygon outward to cover the surroundings, while preserving the western and southern boundaries used by the original demonstrator. Default AOI for the Utsira surroundings reef-biomass experiment.

experimentInput.name: AOI polygon (surroundings of Utsira)
experimentInput.description: Polygon delimiting the broader study area around Utsira island. Reusable across any experiment that operates on this area; carries no equation symbol or CWL port binding.

data.note: Polygon coordinates are carried by the top-level `geometry` field per OGC Records.

provenance.note: Bbox, centroid, and area_km2 are derived from the illustrative polygon drawn in this record's top-level geometry — not from an authoritative licence-area dataset. The polygon is hand-drawn around Utsira island as a surroundings buffer; the actual licensed Utsira Nord polygon is narrower and published by NVE.

nearestAuthoritativeSource.note: NVE strategic assessment hosts the licensed Utsira Nord polygon used by the original ODD demonstrator. For real Norwegian offshore-wind area polygons, retrieve via the Geonorge catalogue (https://www.geonorge.no/) — exact WFS endpoint not verified.
